title: Squirrel eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Tail: big fluffy orange curl -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='42' r='22' fill='#ff9e3d'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='28' r='16' fill='#ffb15e'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='13' fill='#ff9e3d'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='55' r='12' fill='#e8822a'/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='68' rx='20' ry='22' fill='#ffb15e'/>
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='74' rx='11' ry='13' fill='#ffe0b0'/>
  <!-- Back leg -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='84' rx='11' ry='7' fill='#e8822a'/>
  <!-- Front paw -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='62' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#ffcf8a'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='38' r='15' fill='#ffb15e'/>
  <!-- Ear -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='24' r='6' fill='#e8822a'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='24' r='6' fill='#e8822a'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='24' r='3' fill='#ffd9a8'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='24' r='3' fill='#ffd9a8'/>

  <circle cx='56' cy='40' r='2.5' fill='#5a2d1a'/>
  <!-- Snack: acorn held at paws -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <path d='M45 58 Q50 52 55 58 Z' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <rect x='49' y='52' width='2' height='4' fill='#8a5a2b'/>
  <!-- Paw over acorn -->
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='60' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#ffcf8a'/>
</svg>
